job.title: Integration Developer / Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Job title: Integration Developer / Full Stack Software Engineer
Location: United Kingdom
Employment type: Full-time, Permanent

A fast-growing deep-tech AI company turning advanced research into software that customers use in demanding real-world environments. They have a highly capable engineering team and a streamlined interview process.

You’ll build the applications that let customers get the full value from the company’s AI capabilities, and integrate them with existing customer systems and workflows. You’ll work closely with AI developers, engineers and customers, helping shape products from concept through to deployment.

  • Collaborate with Python, C++ and AI engineers

  • Build scalable, maintainable software following engineering best practice
  • Support demonstrations, trials and customer deployments
  • Help maintain a culture of quality, innovation and continuous improvement


Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience delivering integrations between software applications and building integrated workflows
  • Experience developing reliable, production-quality software
  • Strong software design and engineering practices
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-moving environment

Tech environment

  • Front end: React and TypeScript

To apply
Send me an email to kyle@neartechsearch.com or submit your CV

job.title: Junior AI/ML Engineer - Applied Computer Vision
job.description:
Junior AI/ML Engineer – Applied Computer Vision Python | PyTorch | CNNs | Vision Transformers
Employment: Permanent, full-time (contract opportunities may also be available)
About the Company An innovative AI and Machine Learning company developing advanced technologies for defence, security and other high-performance applications. The team specialises in computer vision, perception and autonomy, combining modern deep learning with neuroscience-inspired approaches to develop robust and efficient AI systems.
Its technology spans large-scale image processing and edge deployment, with a focus on turning advanced research into practical AI solutions.
The Role We're looking for a motivated Junior AI/ML Engineer to develop their skills in applied computer vision and machine learning.
You'll work on AI systems using CNNs, Vision Transformers and emerging neural network architectures, learning from experienced engineers and researchers as you build your technical expertise.
This is a hands-on role where you'll write code, run experiments and contribute to the development of production AI systems. You'll receive guidance, mentoring and code reviews while gaining experience across research, software engineering and product delivery.
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and test computer vision algorithms using CNNs, Vision Transformers and other deep learning architectures.
  • Run experiments and analyse results, including training strategies, loss functions and evaluation metrics.
  • Help translate AI research into reliable, production-ready software.
  • Assist with building model training, evaluation and inference pipelines.
  • Support model optimisation for accuracy, speed and deployment across cloud and edge platforms.
  • Contribute to the development of advanced deep learning and neuroscience-inspired AI solutions.
  • Help deliver AI solutions for defence and other high-performance applications.
  • Participate in technical planning, design discussions and code reviews.
  • Learn and apply software engineering best practices while collaborating with experienced colleagues.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Solid foundations in machine learning and deep learning, gained through a degree, personal projects, internships or previous employment.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch; TensorFlow is also beneficial.
  • Understanding of CNNs, Vision Transformers and modern computer vision techniques.
  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Familiarity with version control, testing and code review.
  • Comfortable working in Linux and/or Windows environments.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear communication skills and a willingness to learn and collaborate.

Desirable Experience

  • Object detection, tracking, segmentation or pose estimation.
  • Aerial, satellite or ISR imagery.
  • Edge AI deployment, real-time inference or GPU optimisation.
  • Docker, Kubernetes, Kubeflow or MLOps tools.
  • Synthetic data generation or simulation platforms, such as Unreal Engine or NVIDIA Omniverse.
  • Experience working alongside AI researchers.
  • An interest in defence, government or national security applications.

Education An MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics or a related discipline is desirable. Equivalent practical experience and relevant personal projects are equally welcome.
Security Requirements Candidates must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. BPSS clearance is required, with SC clearance or higher desirable.
Why Join?

  • Work on advanced AI technology rather than incremental applications.
  • Learn from experienced engineers and researchers.
  • Develop skills across both research and production engineering.
  • Contribute to AI systems used in demanding defence and security environments.
  • Build your expertise and take on increasing responsibility as your career develops.

We are recruiting now and operate a streamlined interview process.

job.title: Senior MLOps Engineer - Computer Vision & AI Machine Learning
job.description:
Senior MLOps Engineer – Computer Vision & AI Machine Learning Infrastructure | Model Deployment | Edge AI
Employment: Permanent, full-time

About the Company An innovative AI and Machine Learning company developing advanced technologies for defence, security and other high-performance applications. The team specialises in computer vision, deep learning and autonomous systems, developing AI solutions for deployment across cloud infrastructure and edge devices.
The Role We're looking for an experienced Senior MLOps Engineer to build and improve the infrastructure that takes machine learning models from research and development into production.
You'll help ensure computer vision models can be trained at scale, optimised for inference and deployed reliably across cloud and edge environments, including GPU-powered devices.
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on distributed training, model optimisation, containerisation, CI/CD and production monitoring. You'll work closely with AI developers and software engineers to build scalable, reliable ML infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain distributed model training pipelines.
  • Build experiment tracking and model registry infrastructure.
  • Optimise models for inference using TensorRT, ONNX and quantisation.
  • Develop containerised deployment pipelines for multiple architectures, including edge devices.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building and deployment.
  • Implement production monitoring, observability, metrics and alerting.
  • Manage edge deployment infrastructure for GPU-accelerated video analytics.
  • Develop ML workflow orchestration and event-driven processing systems.
  • Implement data versioning and reproducible training pipelines.
  • Collaborate with AI engineers to productionise computer vision models.
  • Contribute to infrastructure architecture, engineering best practices and technical planning.

Essential Skills & Experience MLOps & Infrastructure

  • Experience with ML experiment tracking and model registries, such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or ClearML.
  • Distributed training frameworks, such as Ray, DeepSpeed, Horovod or PyTorch FSDP.
  • Model inference optimisation using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime or quantisation techniques.
  • Strong Docker and containerisation experience, including multi-architecture builds.
  • CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins.
  • Monitoring and observability tools, such as Prometheus and Grafana.

Software Engineering

  • Expert Python development skills.
  • Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask or Django.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including Git, testing and code reviews.
  • Linux systems administration and shell scripting.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.

Machine Learning

  • Understanding of deep learning training workflows, ideally with PyTorch.
  • Experience with computer vision models and inference pipelines.
  • Familiarity with GPU computing and CUDA environments.
  • Experience delivering production AI systems.

Desirable Experience

  • Edge AI: NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Intel NCS or Coral TPU.
  • Video analytics: NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer or FFmpeg.
  • Workflow orchestration: Metaflow, Kubeflow Pipelines, Airflow or Prefect.
  • Event-driven systems: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis Streams.
  • Model serving: Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, TorchServe or BentoML.
  • Container orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker Swarm or Amazon ECS.
  • Data versioning: DVC, LakeFS or Delta Lake.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Pulumi or Ansible.
  • GPU clusters, high-performance computing and distributed training.
  • Real-time video analytics and aerial, satellite or ISR imagery.
  • Experience working within defence, government or national security environments.

Education An MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or a related discipline is desirable. Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
Security Requirements Candidates must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. BPSS clearance is required, with SC clearance or higher desirable.
Why Join?

  • Build and scale ML infrastructure supporting advanced AI technology.
  • Work across the full machine learning lifecycle, from distributed training to edge deployment.
  • Influence infrastructure architecture and engineering decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with AI developers and software engineers.
  • Contribute to advanced computer vision and deep learning applications within demanding defence and security environments.

We are recruiting now and operate a streamlined interview process.

job.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer (Mobile / React Native)
job.description:
Mid-Level Software Engineer (Mobile / React Native)

Salary: £65,000 – £75,000 per annum
Location: Hybrid (1–2 days/week in Central London office)
Education: STEM degree (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering)

About the Opportunity

My client is a fast-growing, highly ambitious FinTech business backed by significant long-term investment. Operating with strong institutional roots, they are building advanced, highly intuitive financial platforms designed to simplify complex financial operations for their users.
With long-term financial runway fully secured (3–5+ years), they are seeking a highly intelligent Mid-Level Mobile / Software Engineer who wants true ownership, zero bureaucracy, and the autonomy to shape a live, high-impact product.

Why Join Us?

  • True Ownership: We operate a flat structure where everyone has an equal voice. You won't just take tickets; you'll challenge assumptions, suggest new ideas, and take full ownership of features from implementation through testing and release.
  • High Impact & Autonomy: Work alongside seasoned engineering leaders and founders who give smart people the room to create, experiment, and solve complex problems independently.
  • Flexible Hybrid Setup: Collaborative office days in Central London 1–2 days a week, with autonomy to work where you're most productive the rest of the time.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Mobile Development: Build and ship production iOS and Android features end-to-end using TypeScript, React Native, and Expo (Expo Router, EAS).
  • Data Visualisation: Create dynamic, interactive charts, data-visualisation components, and custom UI controls.
  • Integrations & Security: Connect secure REST APIs (auth, token refresh) and integrate third-party payment, broker, and KYC services following strict mobile security standards.
  • Quality & Delivery: Maintain automated tests, run PR code reviews, monitor performance via Sentry, and handle App Store/Google Play releases.


What We Need

  • Academic Excellence: STEM degree (Computer Science, Maths, Physics, Engineering)
  • Core Tech Stack: Solid TypeScript, React, and React Native skills with experience shipping production mobile apps via Expo.
  • Data Visualisation: Hands-on experience building interactive charts, custom drawing, or dynamic data rendering in React Native.
  • Mindset: Proactive problem solver with an owner mentality—curious, pragmatic, and eager to make the product better.


Nice to Have

  • Node.js/Express, SQL, Docker/Azure, GitHub Actions, or Firebase/GA4 analytics


To find out more about the opportunity apply with your up to date CV

job.title: DevOps / Platform Engineer - Mid - £50k - £60k
job.description:
Mid-Weight DevOps / Platform Engineer
Location: UK Remote (Travel roughly 1 day every 1–2 months to London or Manchester)
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000 + Benefits

About the Role

Are you a mid-weight DevOps Engineer with a solid background in infrastructure who thrives in autonomous, close-knit scale-up environments?
Our client is a high-growth UK SaaS provider whose platform powers critical safeguarding and health software across thousands of education trusts nationwide. Operating on a modern AWS stack, they are expanding their platform engineering capabilities and deploying a brand-new cloud region in the UAE alongside their core UK platform.

They are seeking a Mid-Weight DevOps / Platform Engineer with around 4–5 years of experience across DevOps, automation, and core infrastructure. Joining as the second dedicated engineer in the function, you will work directly alongside the DevOps Lead—helping implement platform architecture, building CI/CD pipelines, and taking ownership of internal IT and SysOps.

What You’ll Work On

  • Cloud Platform & IaC: Help implement and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform and AWS CDK across ECS Fargate, Lambda, SQS, CloudFront, and IAM.
  • CI/CD & Observability: Maintain and optimize GitHub Actions deployment workflows and build out New Relic monitoring and alerting as code.
  • UAE Region Expansion: Partner with the DevOps Lead to stand up a brand-new AWS cloud region, gaining direct multi-region rollout experience.
  • IT & SysOps Ownership: Manage internal IT operations, staff onboarding, device management via Jamf (macOS MDM), and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
  • Internal Platform Support: Serve as the internal technical point of contact for infrastructure fixes and onboarding support (strictly internal—no out-of-hours on-call or direct customer support required).

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–5 Years of Technical Experience: Proven hands-on track record across DevOps, cloud automation, and supporting core infrastructure.
  • AWS & Infrastructure as Code: Strong working knowledge of AWS cloud services and IaC using Terraform or CloudFormation/CDK.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Experience setting up or maintaining automated pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).
  • Systems / MDM Experience: Practical familiarity with managing internal IT systems, endpoint management (Jamf or Intune), and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace.
  • Small-Team Adaptability: Comfortable wearing a few hats, collaborating closely in a small engineering team, and learning on the job.
  • AWS Certification: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Associate credential preferred.

Why Apply?

  • Salary: Competitive £50,000 – £60,000 package depending on experience.
  • Great Work-Life Balance: Mostly UK remote (1 day every month or two in London or Manchester) with NO out-of-hours on-call rotation.
  • Direct 1:1 Mentorship: Work closely with an experienced DevOps Lead to level up your platform engineering skills.
  • High-Trust Culture: Everything managed in code with modern tooling and high team autonomy.
  • Generous holiday allowance, pension scheme, and professional development support.

To find out more get in touch with your CV to Heather

job.title: Lead Software engineer - mobile - globally remote
job.description:
Lead Mobile Software Engineer (Product Engineering) Location: 100% Remote (Global)
Package: £85,000 – £100,000 per annum + Meaningful Equity
Employment Type: Flexible / Full-time

About the Role
 Are you a Senior or Lead Mobile Engineer who loves building high-performance, cross-platform mobile apps that interface directly with physical hardware?

We are partnering with a high-growth, venture-backed digital health & wearable technology company on a mission to transform personal health and human performance. Their platform pairs sleek, non-invasive consumer/medical wearable devices with advanced biometric telemetry and data-driven mobile software.

They are seeking a Lead Mobile Software Engineer to take technical ownership of their core mobile software ecosystem. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority for their mobile apps (built with Flutter/Dart and Firebase), bridging the gap between sleek mobile UI/UX, cloud services, and low-level Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) / NFC hardware connectivity.
This is a dual-track role designed for a developer who thrives on being hands-on with code and architecture while serving as a strategic technical advisor to non-technical founders and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Mobile Architecture & Hands-On Engineering: Drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and hands-on development of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter & Dart.
  • Hardware & Biometric Integration: Design robust, low-latency mobile interfaces that communicate with wearable hardware devices via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and NFC, processing real-time physiological telemetry and biometric data.
  • Backend & Cloud Infrastructure: Manage and optimize cloud backends built on Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication) and scalable APIs.
  • AI Workflow Optimization: Champion the integration of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, automated code generation/review) into daily engineering workflows to maximize team velocity and code quality.
  • Technical Ownership & Guidance: Set engineering standards, conduct code reviews, and mentor team members while maintaining active involvement in daily production coding.
  • Commercial Strategy & Trade-Offs: Serve as a key advisor to product and business leadership, making pragmatic technical choices that balance architectural elegance with delivery speed in an agile, early-stage environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Mobile Expertise: Proven track record building and scaling production mobile applications using Flutter & Dart (or strong cross-platform/native iOS/Android experience with a desire to lead in Flutter).
  • Hardware / IoT Connectivity: Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with physical devices, wearables, or sensors via BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy), NFC, or similar wireless protocols.
  • Cloud & Data Pipelines: Experience with Firebase or modern cloud backends, handling data synchronization, real-time streaming, and offline-first state management.
  • Pragmatic Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to act as a technical lead—taking ownership of mobile architecture, guiding junior/peer developers, and communicating technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI-Native Mindset: Active user of AI development tools who understands how to leverage AI to write cleaner code faster.
  • Agile Startup Mindset: Comfortable working in a flexible, fast-moving, early-stage business where adaptability and proactive problem-solving are crucial.

Why Join?

  • 100% Global Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with flexible working hours tailored to your lifestyle.
  • Cutting-Edge Domain: Build software that directly impacts human health and quality of life at the intersection of mobile technology, biometric tracking, and smart wearables.
  • High Ownership & Impact: Be the lead technical voice driving the mobile product from day one with equity in a high-growth company.

Apply for the role and submit your CV to Heather to obtain further details!

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Hardware & Computer Vision
job.description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Hardware & Computer Vision
Location: Hybrid, United Kingdom

About the Company
An innovative AI company developing advanced computer vision solutions for industrial inspection and quality control. The business is expanding its technology across industrial sensing, robotics and edge computing, helping manufacturers improve inspection accuracy and automation through AI-driven systems.

The Role
We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with a strong hands-on background in industrial vision, hardware and sensing technologies to help develop the next generation of inspection systems.

This is a practical, hardware-focused role involving the exploration, prototyping and testing of new technologies across cameras, sensors, optics, lighting and edge computing. You'll take ideas from initial concept through to working prototypes, evaluating new technologies and developing solutions that can be deployed in real-world industrial environments.

Working closely with machine learning, software and engineering teams, you'll help identify new opportunities, build proof-of-concept systems and turn successful experiments into scalable, reliable products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype and validate industrial inspection systems across 2D, 3D, advanced sensing and edge computing.
  • Evaluate emerging cameras, sensors, optics, lighting and embedded systems to identify opportunities for new inspection capabilities.
  • Build and test proof-of-concept hardware, developing practical solutions to complex inspection challenges.
  • Benchmark edge computing platforms, assessing performance, latency, memory usage, thermal behaviour and deployment requirements.
  • Support computer vision model deployment using technologies such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT and OpenVINO.
  • Develop and maintain hardware prototypes, sensor rigs and portable demonstration systems for testing and customer applications.
  • Troubleshoot image quality issues, including lighting variation, glare, blur, calibration drift and inconsistent image capture.
  • Work with cross-functional teams on industrial integration, including PLCs, robotics, camera triggering and industrial networking.
  • Document testing, performance results and technical recommendations to support product development and deployment.
  • Identify promising technologies and recommend which hardware and sensing solutions should progress to further development and commercial application.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience with industrial vision systems, inspection hardware, sensing technologies, robotics or factory automation.
  • Hands-on experience with industrial cameras, lenses, lighting, optics, exposure, calibration and image acquisition.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying edge computing platforms for computer vision applications.
  • Strong Python programming skills for prototyping, testing, automation and hardware integration.
  • Experience troubleshooting computer vision systems, from image acquisition through to model deployment and runtime performance.
  • Familiarity with OpenCV and image processing techniques.
  • Experience designing experiments, benchmarking hardware and evaluating technical performance.
  • Ability to develop practical prototypes and turn complex technical challenges into workable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work across engineering, product and commercial teams.


Desirable Experience

  • Experience with advanced sensing technologies, including 3D cameras, laser scanners, stereo vision, thermal, hyperspectral or X-ray imaging.
  • Knowledge of ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO, model quantisation or edge inference optimisation.
  • C or C++ experience, particularly in hardware integration or performance-critical applications.
  • Experience integrating vision systems with PLCs, robotics, industrial networks or automated inspection cells.
  • Familiarity with industrial camera technologies from manufacturers such as Basler, Cognex, Keyence, SICK or Teledyne.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive, battery production, metrology, non-destructive testing or industrial quality inspection.
  • Experience developing proof-of-concept hardware, test fixtures, demonstration systems or customer-facing prototypes.
  • Experience evaluating new technologies, selecting hardware vendors or leading rapid prototyping projects.


The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a practical, technically minded engineer who enjoys building and testing new technologies, rather than focusing solely on theoretical research or model development.
You'll be comfortable taking an initial idea, identifying the right hardware, building a prototype and rigorously testing its performance. You'll also understand how camera selection, lighting, sensing and edge computing directly affect the performance of computer vision systems in real-world environments.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of hardware innovation, work across a range of emerging technologies and play a key role in developing the next generation of industrial inspection solutions.

Equal Opportunities
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
